items.label: Size
items.value: 7/16- Inch diameter, 6Ft high. Each package contains 25 Pcs sturdy garden stakes for plants. Easy to cut the length as you want, The tapered end is better inserted into the ground.

items.label: Built to Last-Superior Support
items.value: Our premium tomato stakes feature a high-strength steel core with extra-thickened walls for unbeatable durability, resisting bending and warping even under heavy loads. Plastic coated steel tube, excellent performance in UV resistance and chemical resistance. Longer life cycle than bamboo stakes and wood stakes.

items.label: Ridged surface
items.value: Perfect for training plants, ridged surface are great for climbers to grip at they. Works for young plant supporting, eggplant stakes, tomato stakes, pole bean stakes, tree stakes and great for building trellises or teepees for natural climbing plant support .

items: Plant Shaping Pro--- These support stakes intelligently guide plant growth direction, using scientifically-engineered structural support to help plants develop elegant forms. The unique design not only optimizes foliage spatial distribution - ensuring each leaf receives ample sunlight - but also significantly enhances photosynthetic efficiency, ultimately boosting yield potential.

items.label: Versatile Application
items.value: These plant support stakes guide optimal growth direction for various crops. Specifically designed for tomatoes, eggplants, cucumbers and grapevines, our stakes come in multiple sizes to accommodate different cultivation requirements. Suitable for both interior and exterior gardening environments, they represent the ideal support solution for your plants' needs.

items.label: Recommended Uses for Product
items.value: Supporting young plants, securing branches to support plant growth, providing support for trees, shrubs, vines, and other plants

items.label: Special Features
items.value: Plastic coated steel tube, Strong load-bearing capacity, ridged surface

items.label: Style Name
items.value: This plant support stake features a simple and functional light-industrial style, with green plastic-coated hollow metal tubes that blend seamlessly into both outdoor and indoor planting environments. The discreet design prioritizes functionality while maintaining a low visual profile, making it ideal for modern homes or invisible plant support needs.
